title: Protocol for acquiring samples to assess the impact of microplastics on immune microenvironments in the mouse intestine
protocol: Collect fresh feces from the mouse.
Place the mouse in a sterile container and await defecation.
Use sterilized forceps to collect the feces.
Preserve collected feces immediately at -80°C or temporarily freeze them in dry ice before transport.
Euthanize mice according to methods approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee.
Spray 70% ethanol onto the mouse's abdomen and thorax entirely.
Make a horizontal incision of 5–10 mm in the abdomen.
Peel back the skin to expose the peritoneum.
Hold each side of the incision and pull to open the abdomen.
Identify the cecum within the abdominal cavity.
Cut with scissors to pull out the intestinal tissue.
Remove the cecum and small intestine from the mouse.
Cut and open the colonic tissue longitudinally using a blunt-ended scissor.
Wash off fecal contents and mucus by immersing the colonic tissue in CMF PBS at room temperature.
Transfer the colonic tissue to another CMF PBS solution for further washing.
Immediately move forward to the colonic tissue digestion step, or cool the tissue in ice-cold CMF HBSS/FBS before transporting.
Prepare collagenase solution: 1.5 mg/mL Type IV Collagenase dissolved in pre-warmed CMF HBSS/FBS with 40 μg/mL of DNase at 37°C.
Cut the colonic tissue into approximately 1.5 cm pieces.
Transfer it into separate 50 mL conical tubes with 30 mL of pre-warmed CMF HBSS/FBS and 2 mM EDTA.
Use a single 50 mL conical tube for the pieces of colonic tissue per mouse.
Place each 50 mL conical tube horizontally on an orbital shaker pre-warmed to 37°C.
Shake at 250 rpm for 20 minutes.
Put a mesh wire strainer over a waste bucket.
Pour contents of each 50 mL conical tube through the wire strainer to recover 1.5 cm pieces of colonic tissues.
Place recovered tissues in another 50 mL conical tube with 30 mL pre-warmed CMF HBSS/FBS and 2 mM EDTA.
Repeat steps for subsequent tubes.
Pour contents of each tube through the wire strainer again.
Transfer 1.5 cm pieces of colonic tissues to a small plastic weigh boat.
Mince the tissues 10 times using scissors in the weigh boat.
Add minced tissues into 20 mL of collagenase solution.
Place conical tube containing minced tissue and collagenase solution on an orbital shaker for digestion at 200 rpm for 10-15 minutes at 37°C.
Vortex briefly to confirm sufficient dissociation.
Filter the mixture through a 100 μm cell strainer into a new 50 mL conical tube.
Add 30 mL of ice-cold CMF HBSS/FBS and centrifuge at 440 G for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard supernatant to obtain cell pellet.
Repeat centrifugation with addition of 50 mL ice-cold CMF HBSS/FBS.
Discard supernatant after second centrifugation.
Prepare MACS buffer on ice by mixing MACS BSA stock solution and autoMACS rinsing solution (1:20).
Resuspend the cell pellet in MACS buffer with CD45 MACS beads according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Wash cells with MACS buffer and centrifuge at 440 G for 10 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL ice-cold MACS buffer and pass through a 100 μm cell strainer.
Enrich for magnetic bead-attached cells by positive selection using MACS LS magnetic column by passing through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Wash cells with ice-cold CMF PBS and centrifuge at 440 G for 10 min at 4°C.
Repeat step to wash cells once more.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet with 350 μL of RLT buffer to lyse cells.
Purify RNA by using RNeasy Plus Micro kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
